_comment: Single source of truth for MCP servers across Claude Code, Gemini CLI and Codex CLI. Edit here, then run: mcp-sync. Each tool stores MCP config in a different file and a different schema; mcp-sync translates. GitHub Copilot is not part of this ecosystem and is never written to.
_targets: Every server declares who gets it. 'claude' | 'gemini' | 'codex' are global targets, written into each CLI's user-level config. 'role:<role>' is a run-scoped target: the server is NOT placed in anyone's global config, and mcp-sync --run <run-id> writes it only for the identity that holds that role in that run.

context7.note: up-to-date library and framework docs. Read-only, no tenant data, safe for every identity.

atlassian.note: Jira, Confluence and — under an API token with the right scopes and the site linked to your organisation — Bitbucket Cloud. Current Rovo MCP endpoint, HTTP transport; the older /v1/sse entry is legacy. Deliberately not global: there is no permanently privileged orchestrator account, so this reaches whichever identity the user made orchestrator for the run, and only after roles are confirmed. Reads are allowed then; Jira/Confluence/Bitbucket writes still need fde approve-publish. Local git stays the primary interface to Bitbucket repositories.
